page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on the x86_64 architecture and includes hardware support for AVX-512 vector extensions, Intel Deep Learning Boost, and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI.

Performance benchmarks place this instance consistently in the average tier across most compute and memory workloads. It achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 13384.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 35326.14. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1689.81 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 141.73 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Notably, the instance lacks local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, meaning all storage must be network-attached, and GPU-accelerated workloads are not supported. However, it delivers strong performance in specific tasks, such as text generation for small language models, reaching 282.15 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.8xlarge offers high memory density per dedicated vCPU, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local SSD performance. With a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps, it is well-suited for enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and medium-scale web serving.
